summary: Biomea Fusion filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K disclosing a timing update for its Phase I GLP-131 trial of BMF-650 in obese, otherwise healthy volunteers; topline results are now expected in October 2026. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, financing, or structural/regulatory mechanics are stated, and no special-situation transaction is involved. The filing is signed by Interim CEO and Director Michael J.M. Hitchcock, with the registrant remaining a Nasdaq-listed emerging growth company under ticker BMEA. Watch only the October readout as a clinical catalyst, not an event-driven or risk-arb situation.
